text.arabic_uthmani: ۞ أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَانُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةًۭ وَءَاثَارًۭا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَاقٍۢ

words.gloss_range: interrogative-resumptive particle cluster that launches a reproachful question over travel and looking
words.prose: {{ar:أَوَ}} ({{tr:a-wa}}) opens the ayah with interrogation, linkage, and the coming negation compressed into one launch. It turns the prior judgment scene (40:20) into a direct challenge: the audience is being asked why obvious historical evidence has not already been inspected.

topics.headline: rebuking question launch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the verse open as an accusation of neglected evidence, not as a neutral invitation to sightseeing.
topics.reason: The particle cluster is aligned with a rebuking rhetorical question, and the CRITICAL rows cohere around resumption, accusation, and neglected inspection.

words.gloss_range: jussive negator that presents travel as an unrealized expected act
words.prose: {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) negates the following imperfect as an expected act left undone. The grammar makes the first failure a refused path of inquiry: they had the route to evidence, but did not set out.

topics.headline: negated expected travel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the missing journey is treated as culpable failure, not as mere lack of information.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the particle as governing a jussive imperfect, matching the CRITICAL emphasis on failed obligation and reproach.

words.gloss_range: collective jussive travel verb, narrowed by the land phrase and the following looking verb into investigative movement
words.root_gloss_range: broad travel and course-of-conduct field; the local frame narrows it to collective travel used as investigation.
words.prose: {{ar:يَسِيرُوا۟}} ({{tr:yasiru}}) makes the neglected action collective: the addressees were to move through the land's evidentiary field and encounter remains before judging. The intransitive travel is narrowed by the following looking clause into investigation, a pattern also visible when travel through the earth becomes an epistemic method (29:20) and recurs in this surah (40:82).

topics.headline: embodied investigation by travel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that knowledge is being demanded through bodily encounter with historical remains, not through detached speculation alone.
topics.reason: The verb is plural jussive under negation, lacks a direct object, and is followed by a coordinated looking verb, so the travel rows survive as investigative motion.

words.gloss_range: locative preposition marking the domain within which the required travel occurs
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fi}}) makes the travel occur within a domain. The preposition places the audience inside the field where evidence is distributed, preparing for the later traces located in the same terrestrial arena.

topics.headline: land as travel field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the land is the field containing evidence, not a decorative travel backdrop.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the definite land noun and coheres with the repeated locative frame later in the ayah.

words.gloss_range: definite earth or land as the shared arena of inspectable historical evidence
words.root_gloss_range: earth or land as a concrete domain; here it functions as the definite evidentiary field that can be traversed or read.
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-ard}}) names the definite earth as a known arena that can be traversed for evidence. Its repetition later turns the same field into a place inscribed with remains, while the comparison with cultivated and built-up predecessors (30:9) strengthens the sense of earth as witness.

topics.headline: earth as archive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader treats the land as an archive of warning, not as inert scenery.
topics.reason: The noun is definite and recurs in the verse; QAC and CRITICAL rows support a shared evidentiary domain rather than an unspecified location.

words.gloss_range: sequential conjunction binding travel to the act of looking
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) binds travel to looking as a direct sequence. It prevents the first verb from becoming aimless motion: the journey is designed to produce inspection.

topics.headline: travel must become looking
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that movement is not enough; it must immediately become examination.
topics.reason: The prefixed conjunction links the two jussive verbs in order, matching the rows that describe a movement-to-sight chain.

words.gloss_range: collective looking verb governed by the same rebuke, with an embedded how-clause as its content
words.root_gloss_range: seeing, looking, and considering; here physical inspection is fused with reflective judgment.
words.prose: {{ar:يَنظُرُوا۟}} ({{tr:yanzuru}}) carries the same reproach into cognition. The verb has no simple object; the following how-clause supplies the content to be examined, so visible ruins must become reflective judgment, as in the travel-then-look warning pattern (6:11).

topics.headline: reflective observation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the demanded looking is analytical inspection of outcomes, not bare eyesight.
topics.reason: The coordinated jussive form and following manner clause support a fused physical and intellectual act of inspection.

words.gloss_range: fronted interrogative adverb asking about the manner and condition of the outcome
words.prose: {{ar:كَيْفَ}} ({{tr:kayfa}}) fronts manner inside the larger rebuke. The word makes the inspected object analytical: the audience must read the shape of the end, not merely register that an end occurred.

topics.headline: how-question focus
topics.reader_payoff: The reader is pushed to ask how power ended, not merely whether earlier peoples disappeared.
topics.reason: QAC treats the word as the complement of the copula, and the rows converge on manner-focused historical inquiry.

words.gloss_range: perfect copula casting the outcome as an established historical state open to examination
words.root_gloss_range: being, becoming, and state; this ayah uses it to frame settled past conditions and, finally, denied existence.
words.prose: {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kana}}) turns the following outcome into a past state that can be evaluated after the fact. Its delay after the how-word makes quality come before the named outcome, while a parallel stronger-predecessor warning (30:9) confirms the historical frame.

topics.headline: settled past state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the outcome is a settled condition left for later inspection.
topics.reason: The copular grammar and repeated being-root rows support a past-state frame without making the verb itself the object of seeing.

words.gloss_range: nominative outcome noun governing a relative phrase, naming the after-effect assigned to prior peoples
words.root_gloss_range: heel, afterpart, and consequence; the local noun names the end-state that follows prior conduct.
words.prose: {{ar:عَٰقِبَةُ}} ({{tr:aqibatu}}) is the subject of the past-state clause and the head that assigns the outcome to the earlier peoples. The root image of what comes after or at the heel makes the end a readable after-effect; the contrast with a blessed outcome for the wary (28:83) sharpens the moral polarity.

topics.headline: owned consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verse asks about the consequence owned by those peoples, not about their achievements first.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as subject and construct head, while the CRITICAL rows preserve both syntactic headship and afterpart consequence.

words.gloss_range: definite relative pronoun introducing earlier peoples as a transferable example
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhina}}) introduces the prior peoples through relation rather than proper names. They enter the argument as the ones whose outcome is inspectable, so the warning depends on a pattern, not a tribal list.

topics.headline: anonymous exemplary class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the warning widened beyond one named nation into a recognizable class of predecessors.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is governed by the outcome phrase and supports anonymous exemplarity across the row set.

words.gloss_range: plural perfect copula locating predecessors before the audience; variant pressure is secondary to the local clause
words.root_gloss_range: being, becoming, and state; this ayah uses it to frame settled past conditions and, finally, denied existence.
words.prose: {{ar:كَانُوا۟}} ({{tr:kanu}}) locates the predecessors as a past collective condition before the addressees. The first plural copula gives chronology, then the next one will give superiority; the variant coordination noted in the rows can clarify linkage, but the local surface still anchors the relative time clause.

topics.headline: past collective location
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that chronology is the first profile of the predecessors, before their strength is measured.
topics.reason: The local QAC parse is a plural copula introducing the temporal phrase; the variant row is retained as linkage pressure without replacing the canonical syntax.

words.gloss_range: preposition beginning a temporal phrase that marks priorness as a relational starting edge
words.prose: {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) turns the temporal phrase into a relation from before them. It makes the past an evidentiary edge from which the warning approaches, not a vague chronological background.

topics.headline: temporal source edge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the past positioned as a source of evidence for the present audience.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the temporal noun and sets up the comparison clause that follows.

words.gloss_range: possessed temporal noun tying earlier generations directly to the audience horizon
words.root_gloss_range: front-facing orientation and temporal before-ness; here prior generations are positioned before the audience as evidence.
words.prose: {{ar:قَبْلِهِمْ}} ({{tr:qablihim}}) makes priorness relational: the earlier peoples are before them, not simply long ago. The spatial memory of front-facing orientation suits a verse where travel makes the past stand before the eye, and the prior-generation warning formula is comparable to (6:6).

topics.headline: relational before-ness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the past stands before this audience as their own warning horizon.
topics.reason: The suffix and temporal noun are locally secure, and the CRITICAL rows coherently tie before-ness to warning and comparison.

words.gloss_range: second plural perfect copula reopening the profile from chronology to measurable superiority
words.root_gloss_range: being, becoming, and state; this ayah uses it to frame settled past conditions and, finally, denied existence.
words.prose: {{ar:كَانُوا۟}} ({{tr:kanu}}) relaunches the historical profile. The first collective copula located them before the audience; this one gives their superiority its own rhetorical weight, a move parallel to stronger-predecessor warnings such as (30:9).

topics.headline: comparison clause relaunch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verse grants the predecessors real superiority before showing that it could not protect them.
topics.reason: The repeated plural copula opens a new comparative assertion and preserves the two-step profile of pastness then power.

words.gloss_range: independent pronoun foregrounding the predecessors themselves before the comparative adjective
words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) interrupts the clause to focus on the predecessors themselves. That emphasis makes the coming reversal sharper: the very people foregrounded as stronger are the ones seized.

topics.headline: emphatic predecessor focus
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the people themselves, not just their remains or circumstances, are being granted superior strength.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the separate pronoun as emphatic or resumptive, matching the rows that treat it as contrastive focus before the comparative.

words.gloss_range: elative comparative adjective, narrowed by the following specification to superiority in power
words.root_gloss_range: tightening, firmness, severity, and intensity; the local elative narrows this to comparative strength.
words.prose: {{ar:أَشَدَّ}} ({{tr:ashadda}}) encodes superiority in one compressed comparative form, granting the predecessors a stronger test case before seizure overturns it. Its tightening and intensity field is narrowed by the following power specification, while the same strength boast becomes arrogance in another warning (41:15).

topics.headline: comparative intensity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the comparison is deliberately maximized before divine seizure overturns it.
topics.reason: The adjective is an elative predicate with a comparative phrase and specification; the rows cohere around heightened force bounded by local syntax.

words.gloss_range: comparative prepositional phrase supplying the benchmark; second-person variant pressure heightens address without displacing the local third-person surface
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْهُمْ}} ({{tr:minhum}}) supplies the benchmark for stronger-than comparison. In the local surface the suffix is third-person, while the noted second-person variant pressure makes the address dynamics more confrontational; either way, the audience cannot dismiss the ruined peoples as irrelevant others.

topics.headline: audience benchmark
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the present audience is implicated as the standard against which past power is measured.
topics.reason: QAC aligns the local form as a comparative phrase after the elative; variant material is retained only as address pressure, so the topic is narrowed.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative specification naming power as the domain of comparative superiority
words.root_gloss_range: strength, capacity, and ability; the local accusative specifies the domain of comparative force.
words.prose: {{ar:قُوَّةًۭ}} ({{tr:quwwatan}}) specifies the respect in which they were stronger: capacity and force, not moral worth. It comes before the traces noun, moving from possessed power to external footprint, and the contrast with prepared force (8:60) clarifies that force without righteousness cannot shield from judgment.

topics.headline: bounded power domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that power is measured precisely, then denied any protective value.
topics.reason: The noun is an accusative specification after the elative, and the strength rows are locally narrowed to capacity rather than virtue.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction adding traces as a second measure alongside power
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds a second accusative measure to the comparison. It broadens the exhibit from strength possessed by the peoples to marks left in the land.

topics.headline: second measure added
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the indictment expands from internal capacity to visible material imprint.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates two accusative measures and supports the CRITICAL payoff that traces are not a decorative afterthought.

words.gloss_range: plural trace noun coordinated with power and located in the land as inspectable evidence
words.root_gloss_range: trace, mark, remnant, and transmitted effect; the local phrase leans toward material remains in the land while keeping evidentiary force.
words.prose: {{ar:ءَاثَارًۭا}} ({{tr:atharan}}) names the marks left behind as a second domain of greatness. The plural multiplies the evidence, and the land phrase makes those residues answer the opening travel demand; the parallel with earlier earth-work and remains (30:9) deepens the archaeological force.

topics.headline: material traces as testimony
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the remains are concrete testimony in the land, not abstract reputation.
topics.reason: The noun is accusative in coordination with power and is qualified by the land phrase, supporting material remains with evidentiary breadth.

words.gloss_range: locative preposition embedding the traces in the earth
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fi}}) anchors the traces inside a concrete domain. The small preposition turns the large claim about former civilization into something placed where travel can encounter it.

topics.headline: traces embedded in place
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the evidence as materially located rather than merely remembered.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the second land noun and locates the trace evidence in the same field introduced earlier.

words.gloss_range: repeated definite earth noun, now functioning as the storage place of remains
words.root_gloss_range: earth or land as a concrete domain; here it functions as the definite evidentiary field that can be traversed or read.
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-ard}}) repeats the definite earth as the place where traces are held. The first occurrence set the route of inquiry; this one closes the inquiry-evidence loop just before the seizure overturns visible measures, and reasoning through travel in the earth is also emphasized at (22:46).

topics.headline: earth holding traces
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same earth first demanded as travel-field now displays the evidence to be read.
topics.reason: The repeated definite noun links the opening travel field to the trace location, preserving the locative inclusio in the rows.

words.gloss_range: resultative conjunction pivoting from superior power and traces to divine seizure
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) pivots from the inventory of power and traces to the act that nullifies them. The resultative force makes the seizure read as the decisive turn after evidence has been displayed.

topics.headline: pivot to seizure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the reversal: after the exhibit of worldly superiority, judgment arrives immediately.
topics.reason: The conjunction is prefixed to the seizure verb and follows the comparison clause, matching the rows on result and sudden reversal.

words.gloss_range: perfect transitive verb with object suffix, narrowed by the causal sin phrase into culpable seizure
words.root_gloss_range: taking, grasping, capture, and punitive accountability; the local causative tail narrows it to culpable divine seizure.
words.prose: {{ar:أَخَذَهُمُ}} ({{tr:akhadhahumu}}) presents seizure as a completed act that overtook them directly. The object suffix is trapped inside the verb before the divine subject appears, and the causal phrase narrows taking into punitive accountability; the broader formula of being taken for sin appears at (29:40) and is immediately extended in this passage (40:22).

topics.headline: punitive seizure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees judgment as a concrete taking hold of the stronger peoples, grounded in culpability.
topics.reason: The verb is transitive perfect with a plural object suffix and a causal phrase, so the rows on grasp, accountability, and formulaic seizure survive locally.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name as postverbal subject of the seizure clause
words.root_gloss_range: the divine proper name with debated derivational memory; locally it names God as agent and later as the source from whom no shield exists.
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allahu}}) arrives as the explicit subject after the seizure verb and its object. The delayed naming lets the act strike first, then identifies the actor, and the same taking formula is repeated in the following explanation (40:22).

topics.headline: named divine agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader knows the collapse is not impersonal historical decay; God is named as the agent.
topics.reason: QAC marks the divine name as nominative subject, while the CRITICAL rows preserve delayed agency, theological judgment, and immediate formula repetition.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking sins as cause, means, or attached ground of seizure
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) attaches the seizure to the following sins as ground or means. The particle makes culpability part of the event structure before the ayah turns to the final denial of protection.

topics.headline: causal attachment to sins
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ruin grounded in culpability rather than random disaster.
topics.reason: The preposition is prefixed to the possessed plural sin noun and is locally coherent as causal or instrumental attachment.

words.gloss_range: possessed plural sin noun governed by the causal preposition, with tail-image pressure as attached liability
words.root_gloss_range: sin and tail-like after-burden; here the plural possessed noun names accumulated culpabilities attached to the seized people.
words.prose: {{ar:ذُنُوبِهِمْ}} ({{tr:dhunubihim}}) names the sins as theirs and as plural accumulated liabilities. The root image of a trailing burden makes culpability follow the people more decisively than their material traces remain, while the surah contrast between forgiveness of sin (40:3) and seizure by sins here keeps mercy and punishment in moral relation; the singular formula at (29:40) is collective and plural here.

topics.headline: possessed accumulated liability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that what follows them into judgment is their own accumulated culpability, not merely the traces they left in the earth.
topics.reason: The noun is possessed, plural, and governed by the causal preposition; the afterpart and intertextual rows survive as moral-causal pressure without changing the local syntax.

words.gloss_range: conjunction adding the final negated protection clause after the seizure and its cause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds the closing negated clause. It does not soften the seizure; it moves from what happened and why to what kind of refuge did not exist.

topics.headline: turn to negative closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears defenselessness added as a second final fact after seizure.
topics.reason: The conjunction introduces the final negative clause and matches the rows on additive theological closure.

words.gloss_range: negative particle scoping over the existential protection clause
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:ma}}) brings negation to the front of the final clause. Absence becomes the dominant claim: after divine seizure, no protective relation is even available.

topics.headline: existence negated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verse denies the existence of refuge, not merely the success of a known defender.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as governing the following copula in existential negation, preserving the CRITICAL rows on absolute denial.

words.gloss_range: perfect copula in a negated possession/existence clause with delayed protector subject
words.root_gloss_range: being, becoming, and state; this ayah uses it to frame settled past conditions and, finally, denied existence.
words.prose: {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kana}}) frames the final denial as settled nonexistence. The being-root that earlier framed outcome and strength now frames the absence of protection, and the no-protector formula is echoed with another protector noun in this surah (40:33).

topics.headline: negated existential being
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees protection denied at the level of existence and availability, not merely military effectiveness.
topics.reason: The verb forms a negated existential possession clause with a delayed subject, matching the rows on staged removal of refuge and k-w-n closure.

words.gloss_range: prepositional possessive/benefactive marker under negation
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) marks the relation in which protection would have been available to them. Under negation, that possible possession or benefit is cancelled before any protector is named.

topics.headline: denied benefit relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that no protector belonged to their side or advantage.
topics.reason: The prefixed preposition is part of the negated possession frame and locally centers the ruined peoples as would-be beneficiaries.

words.gloss_range: third-person plural pronoun completing the denied possession phrase
words.prose: {{ar:هُم}} ({{tr:hum}}) carries the same group into the no-protection clause. The pronoun chain links comparison, seizure, sins, and lack of refuge without letting the referent drift.

topics.headline: same group carried forward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the stronger, seized, culpable group in view as the ones denied refuge.
topics.reason: The suffix belongs to the possession phrase and coheres with the CRITICAL rows on pronominal continuity and delayed protector naming.

words.gloss_range: preposition before the divine name marking the source or opposing side from which protection would have to shield
words.prose: {{ar:مِّنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) introduces the source from which protection would have to avail. By placing that source before the missing protector, the clause makes the imagined defense impossible before it is even named.

topics.headline: source named before protector
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the impossible source relation is named before any imagined defender appears.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the divine name in the no-protector phrase and sets up the double-min structure completed by the next preposition.

words.gloss_range: divine proper name in genitive after the source preposition, now marking the one from whom no protector exists
words.root_gloss_range: the divine proper name with debated derivational memory; locally it names God as agent and later as the source from whom no shield exists.
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:allahi}}) is governed by the source preposition, shifting the divine name from seizing subject to the source from whom no protector exists. The repeated name closes the action loop, and the same no-protector wording appears in warning form at (13:37).

topics.headline: divine source of inescapability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees God as both the one who seized and the one against whom no shield can stand.
topics.reason: QAC marks the genitive role after the preposition; derivational pressure is retained only as theological density, while the surface meaning remains the source of inescapability.

words.gloss_range: second preposition under negation before an indefinite participle, universalizing absence across the protector class
words.prose: {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) comes after the source phrase and before the indefinite protector. Under negation it universalizes the denial: the clause does not merely reject a named patron but empties the whole class of possible defenders.

topics.headline: exhaustive protector denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that not even one member of the protector category remains available.
topics.reason: The local grammar is the second min-like preposition before an indefinite noun under negation, supporting exhaustive denial in the double-source/generalizing frame.

words.gloss_range: indefinite active participle naming a possible shielding agent whose existence is denied under negation
words.root_gloss_range: guarding, shielding, and prevention; the local indefinite participle under negation denies any active protecting agent.
words.prose: {{ar:وَاقٍۢ}} ({{tr:waqin}}) lands last as the delayed subject of the negated clause, after the earlier exhibit of power and traces has already failed. Its active-participle form would normally name a shielding agent, but indefiniteness under negation empties the role completely; the same no-protector formula appears at (13:37), while this ayah shows it enacted in history.

topics.headline: missing active shield
topics.reader_payoff: The reader ends the ayah on the absence of any active shield, not on the former peoples power.
topics.reason: The word is an indefinite active participle after the second preposition under negation, preserving the rows on shielding, delayed closure, and exhaustive absence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The movement-look construction at words 2-5 is joined to the outcome at word 8 and the marks in the land at words 18-20.
baseline_models.mechanism: Movement through the same land in which earlier peoples left marks makes looking an evidence procedure: the reader follows surviving traces backward to a stronger vanished population and forward to its outcome.

activation_trace.role: Literal movement supplies the embodied search rather than detached speculation.
The doubled land is both the route of inquiry and the substrate retaining evidence.
Directed sight and reflection convert travel into deliberate investigation.
The ending produced by prior action is the object the investigation must reconstruct.
A surviving sign makes an absent historical cause inferable.

changed_reading.before: The ayah invites travelers to notice old ruins.
changed_reading.after: The ayah prescribes an embodied forensic audit in which land-borne traces are evidence linking superior past power to culpable collapse.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The comparison of greater hardness, force, and marks is followed by divine taking and categorical absence of a protector.
baseline_models.mechanism: Hardened force and cord-like accumulated capacity can be externalized in durable works, but none of those capacities becomes insulation from accountability. The verse separates power exercised on the land from power to withstand the consequence of its use.

activation_trace.role: Hardness and force intensify the comparison with the present audience.
Capacity gathered like multiple strands models coordinated material and social power.
Durable marks are the visible output of that accumulated capacity.
Taking as accountability by offense reverses the apparent security supplied by power.
The absent barrier tests whether accumulated capacity can actually avert harm.

changed_reading.before: Even a stronger civilization was destroyed.
changed_reading.after: The ayah distinguishes domination of the land from insulation against judgment: greater coordinated force and greater works still do not function as a shield.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Outcome, marks, and sins occupy one causal sequence, and each inventory can carry an image of what trails behind.
baseline_models.mechanism: The heel or rear, the trace followed after a predecessor, and the tail or end of a thing form a rearward chain. Conduct leaves a moral tail; that tail matures into an outcome, while its material residue remains available to later travelers.

activation_trace.role: The rear or heel gives the outcome a spatial image of what follows behind.
The final result turns that rearward image into temporal consequence.
Following a predecessor's track links the traveler to what the vanished people left behind.
The tail or end image makes culpable conduct carry a trailing consequence.

changed_reading.before: Their sins caused a later punishment.
changed_reading.after: Their conduct carries a moral tail: deed, trailing residue, and final outcome are one chain that later observers can follow.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Travel, those who came before, and their marks can jointly describe both physical movement and access to a prior way of life.
baseline_models.mechanism: The route through land can double as passage through an earlier manner of life, while transmitted report is another kind of trace. The focus remains physical travel, but its epistemic object can include an archived social course, not only masonry.

activation_trace.role: A way or manner of living allows travel to carry a secondary historical-social scope.
Temporal precedence supplies the earlier course through which the reader moves.
A report made transmissible supplies a non-material trace alongside visible remains.

changed_reading.before: Travel means only geographic movement among physical remains.
changed_reading.after: Geographic travel also opens an archive of prior ways and transmitted memory, although the material sense remains primary.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The final construction categorically negates any protecting barrier in relation to God after God takes the prior peoples.
baseline_models.mechanism: Repeated existence language culminates in nonexistence of a barrier. Once culpable taking arrives, neither prior status nor a third-party power stands between the people and the divine agent.

activation_trace.role: Repeated temporal existence contrasts what the peoples once were with what did not exist for them at seizure.
Accountable taking establishes the danger against which protection is tested.
The repeated divine name fixes both the taking agent and the relation in which no counter-agent exists.
Protection is pictured as a damage-blocking barrier, and the negation removes every such autonomous barrier.

changed_reading.before: Nobody happened to rescue the earlier peoples.
changed_reading.after: The close denies any autonomous counter-shield between culpable people and divine consequence, not merely an absent ally.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening coordinates sin with forgiveness, receptive acceptance, severe force, punishment, and return. This revises the baseline trailing-end model: culpable action tends toward an outcome, but accepted return can interrupt that trajectory before the taking described at the focus.

activation_trace.role: The focus tail image supplies the baseline of conduct carrying an end.
The same culpability is explicitly placed under forgiveness rather than treated as mechanically irreversible.
Receptive acceptance supplies an available interruption to the moral trajectory.
Severe force remains the live contrary pole rather than disappearing under mercy.
Punishment following culpability supplies the outcome reached when the opening is not taken.

structural_cues: 40:3 places forgiveness, acceptance of return, severe punishment, and final return in one opening description before 40:21.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the coordinated alternatives; I infer that return can interrupt the deed-to-outcome arrow before seizure. A live alternative is that 40:3 balances attributes without specifying a temporal process.

changed_reading.before: A sin necessarily trails into the observed punishment.
changed_reading.after: The moral tail is conditionally interruptible: 40:21 concerns people whose culpability reached seizure despite an opening for forgiveness and accepted return.

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier community intends to capture its messenger, then the grammatical subject reverses and God captures the communities. The focus taking is thereby activated as a counter-capture answering an attempted coercive capture.

activation_trace.role: The focus taking can retain the concrete force of capture rather than only generic destruction.
The two occurrences span intended capture of the messenger and reversed capture of the communities.
Accountability by offense turns the subject reversal into a morally directed reversal.
The closing punishment identifies the counter-capture as consequence rather than arbitrary rivalry.

structural_cues: Within 40:5, the same taking root occurs before and after a subject reversal: communities target the messenger, then God targets the communities.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical repetition and opposing subjects; I infer a measure-for-measure counter-capture. The live alternative is simple narrative repetition with no retaliatory symmetry intended.

changed_reading.before: God's taking is an unspecified act of destruction.
changed_reading.after: God's taking is also a reversal of coercive power: peoples who tried to capture the messenger are themselves captured by the consequence of that act.

context_deltas.mechanism: Early prayer asks God to protect repentant followers, and later a believer entrusts his affair to God and is protected. The focus therefore cannot mean that protection is impossible as such; it denies a shield against or independent of God while preserving God as the protecting agent.

activation_trace.role: The negated barrier supplies the claim that context must qualify.
A prayer directed to God makes God, not an external power, the requested barrier against harm.
Repeated protection from evil consequences confirms that protective agency remains genuinely available.
Entrusting the affair to another supplies the relational move preceding actual protection.
God's enacted protection of the believer proves the asymmetry between divine refuge and a counter-shield.

structural_cues: 40:7-9 asks God to protect; 40:44 delegates the believer's affair to God; 40:45 immediately reports that God protected him.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies requested and enacted divine protection; I infer that the focus negates protection against or apart from God, not protection by God. A live alternative is that the prepositional relation emphasizes only the source from which no rescue came.

changed_reading.before: Once divine agency enters, protection simply does not exist.
changed_reading.after: Protection exists exclusively as divine protection; what does not exist is an autonomous shield capable of opposing or bypassing God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's account principle pairs recompense with what each self acquired and excludes injustice. This sharpens taking by sins into consequence indexed to acquired action, not guilt by mere membership in a vanished civilization.

activation_trace.role: The focus names culpable acts as the causal attachment of the taking.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies the account's proportional rule.
Acquisition makes the relevant liability something the self actively accumulated.

structural_cues: 40:17 assigns recompense to every self by what it acquired and immediately negates injustice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a general recompense-acquisition rule; I apply that rule to the focus causal phrase. The alternative is that 40:17 concerns final judgment and does not directly specify the historical taking in 40:21.

changed_reading.before: A whole prior people is punished under an undifferentiated label of sin.
changed_reading.after: The taking is presented as an account of acquired culpability, with civilizational membership unable to replace the act-consequence relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah repeats taking, strength, severity, and punishment but moves the predicates of strength and severity from the vanished peoples to God and punishment. It also places clear proofs and rejection immediately before the taking.

activation_trace.role: Accumulated human capacity supplies the original side of the comparison.
Repeated accountable taking is now immediately tied to rejection of clear evidence.
The same capacity image is reassigned to the divine agent and changes the scale of comparison.
Severity migrates from human comparative hardness to the force of punishment.
Punishment following culpability closes the transferred strength sequence.

structural_cues: 40:22 gives a because-clause: messengers came with clear proofs, the people rejected, and God took them.
The focus's human strength and the next ayah's divine strength are adjacent, while severity shifts from people to punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent repeated roots with changed predicate holders; I infer a deliberate scale reversal. The alternative is ordinary emphatic repetition without a designed transfer from human to divine strength.

changed_reading.before: The predecessors' superior force simply failed for an unspecified reason.
changed_reading.after: Their accumulated force meets a different scale of strength, and their seizure answers knowing rejection of disclosed evidence rather than weakness alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Pharaoh sequence moves from present sovereignty displayed in the land to a proposed high structure, then to beautified action and blockage from the way, and finally to the severest punishment. This activates the focus marks as political and monumental surfaces that can advertise control while narrowing perception.

activation_trace.role: Durable marks anchor the changed reading in visible civilizational output.
Sovereignty supplies the political capacity that makes monumental display possible.
Manifest rule is explicitly staged on the same land that later retains the focus evidence.
A high building provides a concrete candidate for power externalized as a visible work.
Making action appear beautiful supplies the perceptual enclosure produced by display.
The sequence terminates by reversing displayed hardness into the severest punishment.

structural_cues: 40:29 joins present dominion, visibility in the land, and the question of rescue from divine might.
40:36-37 moves from the proposed high structure to beautified action, obstruction from the way, and a ruined plan.
40:46 assigns the severest punishment to Pharaoh's people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sovereignty, a high structure, beautification, blocked guidance, and severe outcome; I infer that monumental display can function as epistemic self-enclosure. The live alternative is that the proposed structure was rhetorical or unfinished and should not be treated as one of the focus marks.

changed_reading.before: The marks are neutral measurements of engineering achievement.
changed_reading.after: The marks can be political-monumental displays that materialize sovereignty and beautify a closed account of reality, becoming evidence against the power they once advertised.

context_deltas.mechanism: A book passes as inherited knowledge, and later the surah distinguishes messengers whose stories are recounted from those not recounted. Following a trace and carrying a successive report activate a textual-narrative archive alongside physical remains, while the told-untold distinction limits that archive.

activation_trace.role: A report made transmissible anchors the possibility that a surviving trace can be textual.
Following a predecessor's track supplies the method shared by travel and narrated history.
Transmission of knowledge or book as inheritance provides a durable non-material remainder.
Earlier messengers place narrated history in the same temporal field as the focus predecessors.
Tracking an effect supplies the investigative motion of historical narration.
Successive reporting makes narrated history a carried trace while the repeated negation marks its incompleteness.

structural_cues: 40:53 says the book was passed to the children of Israel.
40:78 says some earlier messengers are recounted and some are not, explicitly limiting the narrated sample.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inherited book, trace-following, and selective narration; I infer that narrated memory supplements the physical archive. The live alternative is that the focus marks remain exclusively material works and the narrative archive is only contextual analogy.

changed_reading.before: Only physical remains can disclose the predecessors' outcome.
changed_reading.after: Physical marks and inherited narration form complementary trace systems, but the surah warns that the narrated historical sample is deliberately incomplete.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah distinguishes blindness from heart-sight, says God displays signs, asks which signs are refused recognition, and then repeats the travel-look formula. Looking therefore requires moral recognition and inference, not retinal exposure to ruins alone.

activation_trace.role: Directed eye and insight anchor the focus demand for interpretive looking.
Blindness of inner perception identifies the failure that can persist despite visible evidence.
Heart-sight supplies the positive capacity needed to interpret the evidence.
Causing signs to appear makes disclosure prior to the observer's response.
Failure of recognition names the active refusal that can follow disclosed signs.
The repeated formula returns directed sight and reflection as the required response.

structural_cues: 40:58 contrasts blind and seeing people and closes by faulting weak recollection.
40:81 says signs are shown before asking which are denied.
40:82 then repeats the focus travel-look question almost verbatim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sight-blindness contrast, displayed signs, refused recognition, and formulaic repetition; I infer that the focus looking is morally diagnostic. The alternative is that these are adjacent themes while 40:21 retains primarily literal visual inspection.

changed_reading.before: Anyone who physically sees the remains has completed the command.
changed_reading.after: Physical exposure is only the input; the demanded looking is heart-level recognition that converts a displayed trace into a moral conclusion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human creation sequence presents full strength as one reached stage between infancy and old age, with some lives taken before it. The focus's superior strength is thus a temporary phase inside a governed life-course, not a stable civilizational property.

activation_trace.role: Superior hardness supplies the apparently durable civilizational attribute.
Reached maturity recasts strength as a bounded developmental stage.
Becoming old places strength inside temporal change rather than permanent possession.
Taking the self before a stage is reached makes the life-course contingent.
Temporal precedence marks possible interruption before the expected endpoint.

structural_cues: 40:67 sequences creation, infancy, full strength, old age, possible earlier death, and an appointed term.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an individual life-course; I analogize its bounded strength-stage to collective power in the focus. The live alternative is that the lifecycle should not be extended from persons to civilizations.

changed_reading.before: Greater strength is a stable possession that unexpectedly fails.
changed_reading.after: Greater strength is itself a reached and passing stage; the traces expose a civilization mistaking a temporary phase for durable security.

context_deltas.mechanism: Late in the surah, boastful joy and over-limit exultation are explicitly located in the land. This turns the focus's force and marks in the land into a possible display economy: works do not merely survive power but can be the means by which power celebrated itself without right.

activation_trace.role: Surviving marks anchor the display in material effects rather than an independent theme.
Boastful delight supplies the affective mechanism by which achievement becomes self-validation.
The same land becomes the arena of display before becoming the archive of its failure.
Joy exceeding its proper measure turns visible success into transgressive performance.

structural_cues: 40:75 twice ties wrongful rejoicing and exultation to conduct in the land.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies land, boastful joy, and excessive exultation; I infer that some focus marks were instruments of celebratory self-display. The alternative is that the affect in 40:75 is general and not materially embodied in the earlier works.

changed_reading.before: The marks are passive remnants left after power.
changed_reading.after: The marks may also be active displays through which power rejoiced in itself, so the land preserves both achievement and the affective error attached to it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near-verbatim reprise adds greater number and closes by saying that acquired resources did not suffice. It functionally glosses the focus's absent protector: demographic scale, coordinated force, visible works, and earnings all fail to become protective sufficiency.

activation_trace.role: The absent barrier poses the question answered by the reprise's failed sufficiency.
Repeated embodied travel marks the second passage as an intentional return to the focus inquiry.
Repeated investigative sight directs attention to the added explanatory details.
Coordinated capacity is repeated as one candidate source of protection.
Visible works are repeated as the material output whose utility is being tested.
Competitive numerical superiority adds demographic scale to the failed protection system.
Failure to suffice supplies the operational test for whether power became protection.
Acquired gain gathers the predecessors' accumulated resources into the final failed category.

structural_cues: 40:82 repeats the travel, land, looking, outcome, predecessors, strength, marks, and land sequence from 40:21.
The reprise adds greater number and replaces the explicit no-protector close with the failure of acquired resources to suffice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies close formulaic parallelism and two different closures; I infer that failed sufficiency functionally explains the absent shield. The alternative is that the reprise narrows the failure to earnings while 40:21 concerns a personal protector.

changed_reading.before: No protector stood between the predecessors and God.
changed_reading.after: Their entire protection system is itemized as a failure: number, coordinated force, visible works, and accumulated gain never became sufficient shelter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus asks for voluntary travel and inference from others' outcomes. The closing scene shows direct sight of divine might followed by belief that no longer benefits, under an established course already passed through earlier servants. The two scenes distinguish reflective sight before consequence from compelled sight inside consequence.

activation_trace.role: Voluntary directed sight supplies the timely observational mode.
Direct sight occurs only once the observers themselves enter the event.
Overwhelming force makes this second sight compelled rather than investigative.
Repeated direct sight confirms that recognition has arrived at the moment of consequence.
The same overwhelming force fixes the late temporal boundary.
An established recurring course connects the final scene back to the earlier peoples.
Passing generations make the established course historical rather than an isolated ending.

structural_cues: 40:84 places profession of belief after direct sight of divine might.
40:85 says that belief then gives no benefit and identifies an established course already passed among earlier servants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies voluntary looking in the focus and non-beneficial belief after compelled sight at the close; I infer two temporal regimes of seeing. The live alternative is that the closing distinction concerns only the timing of faith, not a contrast between kinds of sight.

changed_reading.before: Looking at past outcomes merely confirms a fact about history.
changed_reading.after: Looking is a time-sensitive mercy: infer from others' traces before direct experience forces recognition at a point when recognition can no longer protect.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus occurrence ordinarily denotes offenses, while one supplied branch carries tails or followers. It remains anchored because 40:47 explicitly stages followers attached to arrogant leaders who cannot spare them any consequence. Render it only as a social mechanism of culpability, never as a replacement translation of the focus word.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The taking is attached to the focus root at word 23, whose inventory includes both offense and follower-tail images.

activation_trace.role: Followers or trailing appendages allow culpability to acquire a social attachment pattern.
Allegiance and succession make the followers participants in the leaders' course.
A liability that clings supplies the arrow from following to shared exposure.

changed_reading.before: The sins are only atomized private offenses.
changed_reading.after: Some culpability may be socially tailed: attaching oneself to domineering leadership carries a shared consequence when that leadership proves unable to shield its followers.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain image reversal, not a lexical gloss: the focus strength inventory pictures coordinated strands and binding, while 40:71 supplies collars and connected chain links. It remains anchored in the focus comparison and the punishment sequence. Downstream prose should qualify it as an image-level reversal of organized power into imposed restraint.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins greater hardness and cord-like accumulated force at words 15 and 17 to taking and failed protection.

activation_trace.role: Multiple strands gathered into strength supply the organized bond on the power side.
Tightening a knot or bond gives that organized strength a binding image.
A collar restraining a limb turns binding from possessed organization into imposed confinement.
Connected links reverse coordinated strands into the mechanism of captivity.
Dragging makes the imposed bond operational on bodies once famed for force.

changed_reading.before: Their coordinated strength merely disappears.
changed_reading.after: At image level, the bonds by which power cohered reverse into bonds imposed on the powerful: organized capacity becomes organized restraint.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping for the focus marks and is therefore form-distant and surprising. It remains anchored to the exact focus root and gains contextual support from the high-building project and the repeated marks in the land. Render it as an exploratory material analogy: intervention that stirs or moves earth, not as the direct translation of the focus noun.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus marks at word 18 have a supplied split target whose branch pictures stirring a thing from its place.

activation_trace.role: Stirring or moving material recasts static remains as evidence of active intervention in the land.
The high-building project supplies a concrete case of matter reorganized into monumental form.
The land remains the material field in which intervention and exultation occur.
The repeated split-root occurrence sustains the earth-moving image at the surah's reprise.

changed_reading.before: The predecessors possessed a larger quantity of static remains.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they intervened more forcefully in the earth: the marks register how extensively power stirred and reorganized matter before becoming residue.

strongest_changes: 40:5 turns divine taking into a subject-reversing counter-capture of communities that intended to capture their messenger.
40:7-9 and 40:44-45 revise no protector into an exclusivity claim: God protects, but no shield can oppose or bypass God.
40:22 transfers strength and severity from the vanished peoples to God and punishment while specifying rejected clear evidence as the immediate cause.
40:82 explains failed protection through a near-verbatim reprise in which number, force, marks, and earnings do not become sufficiency.
40:84-85 turns voluntary looking at others' traces into timely recognition before compelled sight arrives too late to benefit.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah reconstruction made 40:21 a hinge rather than an isolated ruins warning: the Pharaoh sequence instantiates displayed power, the protection scenes resolve the final negation, and the near-verbatim 40:82 reprise supplies an explicit functional explanation of failure.
remaining_uncertainties: The precise force of the relation to God in the no-protector clause can emphasize opposition to God, source of rescue, or both.
The monumental and narrated-trace readings plausibly supplement visible remains, but neither should erase the ordinary material sense.
The follower-tail, bond reversal, and non-dominant earth-moving activations should remain explicitly exploratory rather than enter an unqualified synthesis.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Travel converts remains into causal evidence.** `س ي ر/B001` gives forward movement, `ن ظ ر/B001` directed sight or insight, and `ء ث ر/B003` a surviving mark of what occurred. Their sequence supplies movement → inspection → inference. I infer that traces preserve absent causes; the command reads travel as an empirical method for reading historical outcomes.
2. **The outcome is what follows conduct, not what strength predicts.** `ع ق ب/B006` supplies final aftermath, while `و ق ي/B001` is a barrier that could ward harm but is negated. I infer that visible power cannot interrupt the deed-to-outcome arrow; “stronger and more marked” becomes counterevidence to reliance on capacity.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The near-repetition in 40:82 adds one surprise: accumulated gain, not only military strength, also fails to convert monumental traces into protection.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Travel becomes forensic reading of durable marks.** Lexically, `ء ث ر:B003` is a "remaining sign that points to what was," `ن ظ ر:B001` directs sight or insight to apprehend, and `ع ق ب:B006` is end and outcome. Structurally, movement across land leads to directed looking, then from surviving marks to the prior people's outcome; 40:19-20 have just established minute evidence and true judgment, while 40:23 introduces signs again. The traces serve as witnesses from which an invisible causal history can be reconstructed. The packet supplies travel, looking, marks, seizure, and sins; I infer that the marks are to be read as effects of that seizure. The journey is thus an evidentiary procedure, not sightseeing or a generic history reminder.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 40:82 repeats the travel frame but adds failed earnings, unexpectedly turning the earlier traces from monuments of punishment into an economic audit of what could not avail.

findings.text: Yeryüzünde yolculuk, kalıntıları geçmişteki görünmez nedenlerin tanıkları olarak okuyup sonuç çıkarmaya yarayan bir inceleme yöntemine dönüşür.
Sonuç, görünür gücün öngördüğü şey değil, davranışın peşinden gelen aşamadır; büyük güç bile zarar ile kişi arasına koruyucu bir engel koyamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin ülkesinden zorla çıkarılıp uzaklaştırıldığı yapı için uygundur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal, kişinin ülkesinden çıkarılmasını ve hayvan örtüsünün alınmasını özel olarak belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, yapı, elde tutulan şey ve başka nesneler dahil daha geniş bir yerinden söküp alma alanına sahiptir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi anlamı yolculuk eden topluluk ve yolcu kafilesi olarak açıkça verir. Dal çerçevesi topluluğu hareket eyleminin kendisinden ayırdığı için kaynak sınırına uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yol alma eylemini değil, birlikte yol alan insanlardan oluşan topluluğu adlandırır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın sözcüğün yolculuk eden topluluk anlamıyla sınırlıdır; tek yolcuya, taşıta veya hareket eylemine genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Birlikte yol alan insanlardan oluşan yolcu topluluğu veya kafiledir.

facets.statement: Gönderge, tek kişi değil birlikte yol alan bir insan topluluğudur.
Topluluk düzenli bir yolcu kafilesi olarak düşünülebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar sözcüğü birlikte yol alan insan topluluğu olarak tanımlar ve bunu yolcu kafilesiyle açıklar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Birlikte hareket eden insan grubunu, eylem veya taşıt anlamı eklemeden karşılayan genel ifadedir.

error_profile.preserves: Birlikte yol alma ve bir topluluk oluşturma özelliklerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yolculuk eden topluluğun düzenli ve birlikte hareket eden bir grup olduğu bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yolculuk eden insanların birlikte oluşturduğu topluluk anlamını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, yol arkadaşlığı ve aynı yolculuktaki eşlik bağını özellikle öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da birlikte yolculuk eden insan grubunu gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal grubun topluluk kimliğini adlandırır; komşu dal aynı gruptaki eşlik ve arkadaşlık ilişkisini daha belirgin taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalda taşınan yük veya yolculuğun amacı belirtilmeden yolcu topluluğu anlatılır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, yiyecek yükü taşıyan insanları, develeri ve yükleri özel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: yolcu topluluğu ile azık taşıyan kafile
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yol üzerinde birlikte hareket eden bir grup görünümünde buluşabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı kuran özellik toplu yolculuktur; komşu dalı kuran özellik ise yiyecek yükünün taşınmasıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli bir öğüt kalıbını görmezden gelme, katlanma, çekişmeyi ve kuşkuyu bırakma sözleriyle açıklar. Dal çerçevesi bunun gerçek bir yürüme buyruğu olmadığını doğru biçimde belirtir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnızca kalıplaşmış öğütte ortaya çıkar; sözcük burada fiziksel olarak ilerleme buyruğu değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca görmezden gelmeyi, katlanmayı ve çekişmeyi bırakmayı öğütleyen sabit söz için geçerlidir; yalın harekete aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir öğüt sözünde, çekişmeye ve kuşkuya takılmayıp görmezden gelmeyi, katlanmayı ve tartışmayı bırakmayı bildirir.

facets.statement: Söz, rahatsız edici bir durumu görmezden gelmeyi ve ona katlanmayı öğütler.
Öğüt özellikle çekişmeyi ve kuşku üzerinde durmayı bırakmayı içerir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu dal için kaynaklar arası ortaklaştırılabilecek ek bir içerik yoktur; anlam tek tanıklıkta sabit bir öğüt sözü olarak verilir.

source_details.summary: Sabit söz, görmezden gelmeyi, katlanmayı ve çekişme ile kuşkuyu bırakmayı öğütler.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sabit sözün öğüt kipini ve birlikte taşıdığı üç kurucu yönü doğal Türkçe ile verir.

error_profile.preserves: Görmezden gelme, katlanma ve çekişmeden vazgeçme öğüdünü birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kuşku veya çekişme üzerinde durmamayı öğütleyen gündelik bağlamlarda doğal bir karşılıktır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal belirli bir söz içindeki buyruğa bağlıdır; komşu dal ise süreklilik gösteren bir huyu veya genel tutumu anlatabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, kusurlu bir malı bilerek görmezden gelme ve bedelde ödün verme gibi alışveriş durumlarına uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: çekişmeyi bırakmak ile kusuru görmezden gelmek

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal tartışmayı sona erdiren genel bir öğüttür; komşu dalın belirgin kullanımı kusurlu alışverişte bilinçli ödün vermedir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalın bir biçim için azık, başka bir biçim için azık arayıp edinme anlamını verir. Üçüncü biçim içinse yalnızca bu kökten türemiş sayıldığı belirtilir; bağımsız bir nesne veya eylem anlamı verilmediğinden dalın anlam çekirdeğine ayrı bir kavram olarak eklenemez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın kanıtlanmış anlamı azık ve azık edinmedir; üçüncü biçim yalnızca türeyiş notuyla sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım tek başına kullanılan biçimlerin azık ve azık edinme anlamlarına dayanır; bağımsız anlamı verilmeyen türemiş ad için yeni bir anlam çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yolculuk veya geçim için hazırlanmış yiyecek ile bu yiyeceği arayıp edinme eylemidir. Bir başka ad yalnızca bu kökten türemiş sayılır; onun bağımsız anlamı kanıtlanmaz.

facets.statement: Nesne anlamı, yolculuk veya geçim için edinilen yiyecektir.
Eylem anlamı, gerekli yiyeceği arayıp elde etmektir.
Bir adın bu kökten türemiş sayıldığı bildirilir, ancak o ad için bağımsız bir anlam açıklanmaz.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu dal için kaynaklar arası ortaklaştırılabilecek ek bir içerik yoktur; tek tanıklık azık, azık edinme ve sınırlı bir türeyiş notu verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, göğün karşısında aşağıda bulunan ve üzerinde yaşanan yeri temel anlam olarak verir; nesnelerin yere bakan altı ile hayvan ayağının alt bölümü de buna bağlı kullanımlardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Temel yer anlamı ile yalnız tamlamalarda beliren alt bölüm ve hayvan ayağı anlamları birbirinden ayrılmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın yer anlamını kapsar; alt bölüm ve hayvan ayağı anlamlarını ise yalnız belirtilen tamlamalara bağlı yan yüzler olarak tutar.

concept_map.definition: Göğün karşısında aşağıda bulunan, üzerinde yaşadığımız yer küresini belirtir. Belirli tamlamalarda bir şeyin yere bakan altını ve hayvanın tırnağını ya da ayağının alt bölümünü de anlatır.

facets.statement: Göğün karşısında aşağıda bulunan ve üzerinde yaşanan yer küresidir.
Bir şeyin yere bakan alt bölümü, belirli bir tamlama içinde bu adla anılır.
Hayvanın tırnağı veya ayağının yere değen alt bölümü için kullanılan özel bir tamlama vardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, anlamın merkezinde göğün karşısındaki aşağı yerin bulunduğunu; alt bölüm ve hayvan ayağı kullanımlarının bu mekansal çekirdeğe dayandığını birlikte gösterir.

concept_gloss.text: yer ve yere bakan alt bölüm
concept_gloss.applicability: Yer küresi anlamını ve ona bağlı alt bölüm yönelimini birlikte özetleyen en kısa doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Aşağıda olma, göğe karşıt konum ve yere bakan alt bölüm ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Üzerinde yaşanan ve göğün karşısında bulunan yer küresi söz konusu olduğunda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Üzerinde yaşanan aşağı yer ve göğe karşıt konum anlamını korur.
error_profile.loses: Nesnelerin altı ile hayvan ayağının alt bölümüne bağlı kullanımları dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Geniş ve düz araziyi, ayrıca serilip yayılan eşyayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da yayılmış bir yüzey olarak yer alanına dokunur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yumuşak, iyi ve verimli toprağı merkez alır; bitkinin köklenip çoğalması veya biçilecek duruma gelmesi ile oğlağın bu ottan yiyip semirmesi buna bağlı gelişmelerdir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Toprağın niteliği çekirdektir; bitkinin gelişmesi ve oğlağın beslenmesi sonuç ya da ilişkili kullanım olarak kalmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, nitelikli toprak anlamını yalnız kanıtlanan tamlamalara; bitki, fidan ve oğlakla ilgili anlamları da kendi kanıtlanmış yapılarına bağlar.

concept_map.definition: Belirtilen yapılarda yumuşak, iyi, verimli ve bol bitki yetiştiren toprağı anlatır. Buna bağlı yapılarda bitkinin toprağa iyice yerleşip çoğalması veya biçilebilir olması, köklü fidan ve yer bitkisini yiyen oğlak; ayrı bir kaynak kullanımında ise semiz oğlak ifade edilir.

facets.statement: Toprak veya çayırlık yumuşak, verimli ve iyi bitki yetiştirir.
Bitki toprağa iyice yerleşir, çoğalır veya biçilecek olgunluğa ulaşır.
Oğlak yer bitkisini yer.
Bir kaynakta ilgili niteleme semiz oğlağı belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Birleşik kanıt, verimli ve yumuşak toprağı; bu toprakta gelişen bitkiyi ve bitkiden yararlanan oğlağı aynı üretkenlik ilişkisi içinde toplar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın toprak niteliğine dayanan çekirdeğini eksiksiz ve doğal biçimde karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Toprağın yumuşaklığını, iyiliğini, verimini ve bitki yetiştirme gücünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bitkinin toprağa yerleşerek çoğalması anlatılan bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bitkinin toprağa yerleşmesi ve gelişerek çoğalması sürecini korur.
error_profile.loses: Toprağın genel niteliğini ve oğlağın bu bitkiyle beslenmesi yüzünü dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yumuşak, verimli ve bol bitkili toprak
bitki iyice köklendi, çoğaldı veya biçilecek duruma geldi
oğlak yer bitkisini yedi veya onunla semirdi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bitkinin yerleşmesi, biçilebilir olması ve oğlağın bitkiyle beslenmesi gibi bağlı kullanımları vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kolay işlenen yer ve bitkinin hızlı yetişmesi özelliklerini daha genel biçimde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da verimli, iyi bitki yetiştiren toprağı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yumuşaklık ve iyi bitkilenmeyle birlikte belirli bitki ve oğlak yapılarını taşır; komşu dal kolaylık ve hızlı yetişme niteliğine uzanır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; verimli toprak çekirdeğine en yakın olup kapsam farkı taşıyan kart seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: الأرض الأريضة والروضة الأريضة؛ الأرض الزاكية الحسنة النبت؛ النبات المتأرض إذا تمكن في الأرض وكثر أو أمكن جزه؛ الجدي الأريض إذا تناول نبت الأرض أو سمن

branches.source_phrase_ar: أرض أريضة لينة طيبة (maqayis;ayn)؛ أرض أريضة أي زكية (sihah)؛ حسنة النبت (mufradat)؛ تأرض النبت إذا أمكن أن يجز (maqayis;sihah)؛ تأرض النبت تمكن على الأرض فكثر (mufradat)؛ تأرض الجدي إذا تناول نبت الأرض (mufradat)؛ جدي أريض أي سمين (sihah)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli yapılarda bir kişinin iyiliğe yatkın, ona layık ve alçak gönüllü oluşunu; karşılaştırmalı yapıda ise bir işi yapmaya en uygun kişi sayılmasını bildirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız verilen kişi ve eylem yapılarında geçerlidir; genel bir kök anlamı veya doğrudan ahlaki iyilik adı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım bütünüyle belirtilen kişi ve eylem tamlamalarına bağlıdır; yalın biçime bağımsız bir uygunluk anlamı yüklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli yapılarda bir kişinin iyiliğe yatkın ve ona layık olmasını anlatır; bir kaynak bu niteliği alçak gönüllülükle birlikte verir. Karşılaştırmalı kullanımda ise bir işi yapmaya başkalarından daha uygun olmayı bildirir.

facets.statement: Kişi iyiliğe yatkın ve ona layıktır.
Karşılaştırmalı yapıda kişi, belirli bir işi yapmaya grubun en uygun üyesidir.
Bir kaynak bu kişi niteliğini alçak gönüllülükle birlikte verir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, iyiliğe yatkınlık ve layıklık ile belirli bir eyleme en uygun olma yargısını yapı bağımlı tek bir uygunluk alanında birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız kişi hakkında kurulan belirtilmiş yapıda dalın temel niteliğini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: İyiliğe yönelme, uygunluk, layıklık ve olumlu kişilik değerlendirmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluk içinden belirli işi yapmaya en uygun kişi seçildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli eyleme başkalarından daha uygun ve layık olma karşılaştırmasını korur.
error_profile.loses: İyiliğe yatkın ve alçak gönüllü kişi niteliğini dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: iyiliğe yatkın, layık ve alçak gönüllü kişi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İyiliğe yatkınlıkla birlikte alçak gönüllülük çağrışımı ve belirli kalıplara bağlılık taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Herhangi bir şeye hazır, uygun veya layık olmayı daha geniş biçimde anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir kişi ile uygun görüldüğü nitelik veya eylem arasındaki yatkınlık ilişkisini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal iyilik alanına ve iki belirli yapıya bağlıdır; komşu dalın uygunluk ve hazır oluş kapsamı daha geneldir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm komşular değerlendirildi; genel layıklık alanıyla karışma olasılığı en yüksek olan karşılaştırma yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: الرجل الأريض للخير؛ آرض القوم أن يفعل الشيء أي أخلقهم به
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الأرض الحسية ولا الزكام ولا الرعدة
branches.source_phrase_ar: رجل أريض للخير أي خليق له شبه بالأرض الأريضة (maqayis)؛ رجل أريض أي متواضع خليق للخير (sihah)؛ هو آرضهم أن يفعل ذلك أي أخلقهم (sihah)

identity_judgment.rationale: Tek kaynak ifadesi, sabit bir adlandırmanın doğrudan yabancı kimse anlamına geldiğini belirtir; yer sakini veya soy bağına ilişkin daha ayrıntılı bir koşul kurmaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu anlam yalnız sabit adlandırmaya aittir ve genel olarak yeryüzünde yaşayan kişiyi anlatmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız kanıtlanan sabit söz birimine bağlanır; parçaların yalın anlamlarından yeni bir kişi sınıfı türetilmez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir sabit adlandırmada, bulunduğu çevreye dışarıdan gelen veya oraya ait olmayan yabancı kimseyi belirtir.

facets.statement: Sabit söz birimi, bir yerde yabancı olan kimseyi adlandırır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kanıt, söz biriminin yabancı kimseyi belirten kısıtlı ve kalıplaşmış bir adlandırma olduğunu gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız kanıtlanan sabit adlandırmanın kişi anlamını doğal biçimde karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin bulunduğu yere veya topluluğa ait olmaması anlamını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yabancılığı herhangi bir ek topluluk koşulu vermeden sabit bir adlandırmayla bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kişinin kendisinden olmayan bir topluluğun içine girmiş bulunmasını özellikle belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bulunduğu insan çevresine aslen ait olmayan kişiyi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın kanıtı yalnız yabancı olmayı söyler; komşu dal yabancının başka bir topluluk içinde bulunması koşulunu açıkça taşır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün aday kartlar değerlendirildi; genel yabancı anlamına en yakın, fakat topluluk koşuluyla ayrılan komşu seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: ابن أرض إذا أريد الغريب
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس ساكن الأرض مطلقا ولا الأرض التي نحن عليها
branches.source_phrase_ar: فلان ابن أرض أي غريب (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi nesneyi kalın, büyükçe bir yaygı olarak tanımlar ve malzemesini yün ya da hayvan kılıyla sınırlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal genel yer, hasır, döşek veya süslü kumaş değil; malzemesi ve kalınlığı belirtilmiş bir yaygıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın adın kanıtlanan nesne anlamıyla sınırlıdır ve komşu döşeme türlerinin özelliklerini içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Yünden veya hayvan kılından yapılmış kalın ve büyükçe bir yaygıdır.

facets.statement: Nesne, yün ya da hayvan kılından yapılmış kalın bir yaygıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar nesnenin yaygı oluşunda, kalınlığında ve yün ya da hayvan kılından yapılmasında birleşir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Nesnenin türünü, belirleyici kalınlığını ve iki olası malzemesini birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Yaygı türünü, kalın yapıyı ve yün ya da hayvan kılı malzemesini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yaygının kalın ve özellikle yün ya da hayvan kılından yapılmış olmasını gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Döşek, yatak örtüsü ve genel olarak alta serilen nesneleri kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da zemine ya da yatma yerine serilen ev eşyalarını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal malzeme ve kalınlıkla tanımlanan belirli bir yaygıdır; komşu dal işlevi bakımından daha geniş bir döşeme sınıfıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Sağlanan kartların tümü değerlendirildi; nesne türü bakımından en yakın fakat kapsamı daha geniş döşeme komşusu yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: الإراض بالكسر؛ بساط ضخم من وبر أو صوف
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الأرض ولا الأرضة ولا الأريضة
branches.source_phrase_ar: الإراض بساط ضخم من وبر أو صوف (maqayis)؛ الإراض بالكسر بساط ضخم من صوف أو وبر (sihah)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişinin yere bağlı kalmasını, yere doğru ağırlaşmasını ve bunun sonucu oyalanıp gecikmesini aynı hareket durumu içinde verir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yere yönelen ağırlık ve kalma durumudur; tembellik, geri kayma veya bir başkasına karşı çıkma değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın eylem dalının yere bağlı kalma, ağırlaşma ve gecikme bileşenleriyle sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin yere bağlı kalmasını veya yere çökercesine ağırlaşmasını ve bu yüzden bir süre oyalanıp gecikmesini anlatır.

facets.statement: Kişi yerden ayrılmayarak yere bağlı kalır.
Yere doğru ağırlaşma, oyalanma ve gecikme olarak gerçekleşebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, yere bağlı kalmayı çekirdek alır ve yere doğru ağırlaşma ile oyalanmayı bu durumun görünüşleri olarak birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yere bağlılık, ağırlaşma ve gecikme bileşenlerini tek bir eylem karşılığında toplar.

error_profile.preserves: Yere yönelişi, ağırlığı, yerinde kalmayı ve bunun doğurduğu oyalanmayı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin doğrudan yere bağlı kalması öne çıktığında kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Yere bağlı kalma ve bulunduğu noktadan ayrılmama durumunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Yere doğru ağırlaşma ile oyalanıp gecikme görünüşlerini dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İnsan için yere doğru ağırlaşma ve bununla birlikte oyalanma anlamını taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İnsan dışında kuş ve yırtıcıları, ayrıca yuva ve yerinde ağır duran nesne örneklerini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da yere yakın durma ve bulunulan yerden ayrılmama durumu vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kişinin yere doğru ağırlaşıp gecikmesini anlatır; komşu dal farklı canlı ve nesnelerde yere yapışma ya da sabit kalma alanına daha geniş yayılır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; yere bağlı kalma çekirdeğini en doğrudan paylaşan ve kapsam farkını gösteren komşu seçildi.
